definitions.first_vs_final: x = first recorded solve error; y = archived submitted coefficient error. Both use evaluator ground truth.
definitions.observed_improvement_ratio: First divided by last recorded solve error, only for >=2 recorded solves with valid endpoints and positive last error; single solves remain separate.
definitions.trajectory_error_visibility: True coefficient errors are evaluator-only and are not numerical feedback delivered to the model.
definitions.action_raster: A mark indicates at least one command request of that type in a turn, parsed from recorded assistant text and validated against archived parsed_actions; not necessarily a completed tool call.
definitions.exemplar_selection: Fixed before reading outcomes: medium seed 1, smallest recorded seed, comparing Pro and Opus because of their equal aggregate medium success counts.
definitions.zero_log_values: If zero errors occur they are explicitly counted and plotted at half the smallest positive error; no zero is silently discarded.

source_confidence_exclusion_context.interpretation: At the confidence correctness threshold, including source f would add an always-correct outcome class in this archive. This documents an analysis rationale, not the original historical motivation.
